title: Simple Elytra Bounce
description: Elytra Bounce completely negates kinetic damage when you crash into Slime Blocks, instead, reflecting your flight velocity. It allows you to sustain your momentum and chain massive bounces.
body:
Makes slime blocks act as bouncy as they should when flying into them.

###  Features
- **Slime Bouncing:** Hitting a Slime Block while gliding with an Elytra perfectly reflects your velocity, bouncing you backwards!
- **Zero Kinetic Damage:** Kinetic damage is completely negated when you successfully bounce off a slime block.
- **Firework Rocket Physics:** If you bounce while actively boosting with a firework rocket, the rocket is gracefully destroyed so it doesn't fight your bounce momentum!
- **Highly Configurable:** Modify your bounce strength and required speed through the config file. Want to accelerate every time you bounce? Just turn up the multiplier!

###  Configuration
On first launch, the mod generates `config/elytrabounce.json`.
- `bounceMultiplier` (Default: `1.2`): The speed multiplier when bouncing. Values above `1.0` will speed you up upon impact!
- `minBounceSpeed` (Default: `0.1`): Minimum incoming velocity required to trigger a bounce.
- `giveBoostOnBounce` (Default: `false`): Artificially grants an extra massive boost when you bounce.

###  Installation
Requires **Fabric API**. Then download as normal.
